statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tuesday’s cash session is closed. Reuters’ close and fresh Finviz context show broad weakness with oil and yields elevated, while semiconductor breadth was mostly positive. Direct live NQ price-path evidence is unavailable during the maintenance interval; Tail remains low and Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below WATCH at the assessment cutoff; the next conditional checkpoints are the futures reopen, Wednesday’s 12:30 UTC data and cash-open sequence, and the 18:00/18:30 UTC FOMC sequence.
headline: Post-close Tail stays low while oil, yields and Wednesday’s FOMC keep Stress extreme
body: Reuters reported the Nasdaq Composite closing 0.78% lower as benchmark Treasury yields breached 5%; Brent settled at $108.75 and WTI at $105.83. Fresh supplementary Finviz context showed six of eight tracked megacaps lower but five of seven semiconductors higher. High Stress is not itself evidence of a pathological NQ path.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 UTC clock-hours, Tail ranged from 18% to 23%. It was low overnight, moved into WATCH through much of Tuesday’s premarket and late U.S. session, peaked at 23% in power hour, and returned to 19% after the cash close while Stress remained extreme.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is low because the cash session is closed and direct live NQ mean-reversion-failure evidence is unavailable, while fresh breadth is internally mixed. Wednesday’s 12:30 UTC data, 13:30 UTC cash open, and the 18:00/18:30 UTC FOMC sequence are the main conditional path-risk checkpoints.

forecast.analysis: Tuesday’s cash session is closed. Reuters reported a lower Nasdaq close, elevated Treasury yields and $108-plus Brent; fresh Finviz context shows broad megacap weakness but mostly positive semiconductors. Direct live NQ path evidence is unavailable during the maintenance interval, so Tail is low while Stress is extreme.
drivers: Cash session closed with broad equity weakness
Fresh Finviz shows 6 of 8 megacaps lower but 5 of 7 semiconductors higher
Direct live NQ path evidence unavailable during maintenance

Oil settles $3 higher on Yanbu disruption, Saudi cargo cancellations

forecast.analysis: At the futures reopen, Tail stays low if price discovery is two-sided and retracements are available. A renewed one-way extension with shallow pullbacks would be the first path-based reason to move back toward WATCH.
drivers: Persistence of high oil and yields

forecast.analysis: Late-evening Tail remains low if the reopen does not develop repeated extension. Persistent oil or yield pressure matters more for Tail only if NQ begins rejecting counter-moves and holding near an extreme.
drivers: Oil and rates remain Stress drivers

forecast.analysis: Into midnight UTC, the baseline remains low Tail under balanced trade. A clean directional break followed by failed retracements would invalidate that baseline; headline volatility by itself primarily sustains Stress.
At the Asia handoff, Tail stays low if directional efficiency fades and ordinary pullbacks remain available. Cross-session continuation with little retracement would be the key escalation checkpoint.

Early Asia remains a low-Tail window if price action rotates rather than extends. A fresh geopolitical or energy shock would raise Tail materially only if NQ shows sustained directional follow-through.
drivers: Geopolitical or energy shock only matters with NQ follow-through

forecast.analysis: Overnight risk remains dominated by Stress if mean reversion remains available. Repeated extension after failed pullbacks would be the contrary path evidence needed for a higher Tail band.
In the quieter overnight hour, low Tail assumes no sustained session-extreme holding. A persistent directional grind with shallow pullbacks would be the main invalidation signal.
Approaching the European transition, Tail remains low if the overnight range continues to admit retracements. A directional break that persists through the handoff would raise concern.
During the early European transition, Tail stays low under two-sided discovery. Alignment of NQ direction with renewed yield and oil pressure would matter only if pullbacks also fail.
drivers: Yield and oil alignment if NQ confirms

forecast.analysis: European cash hours remain low-Tail if directional moves retrace normally. Persistent one-way extension across multiple hourly windows would be the required evidence for escalation.
drivers: Stress remains high without automatic Tail escalation

forecast.analysis: Later European trade carries modestly higher conditional Tail because U.S. event risk approaches. A pre-U.S. directional build with shallow retracements would raise path risk before the data.
The U.S. premarket window remains below WATCH if positioning stays two-sided. A widening gap plus aligned yields, oil and tech weakness would lift Tail only if NQ also shows failed retracements.
drivers: Aligned yields, oil and tech weakness only if NQ confirms

forecast.analysis: The hour before the major U.S. data keeps Tail below WATCH if persistent pre-release structure is absent. Event importance raises Stress; it does not by itself establish a pathological price path.

Into the 12:30 UTC release window, conditional Tail reaches WATCH because Retail Sales and import/export prices can reprice rates and equities. Escalation still depends on observed post-release extension, shallow pullbacks or failed retracements.
drivers: Retail Sales and import/export prices at 12:30 UTC

forecast.analysis: The 12:30 UTC data hour carries WATCH-level conditional Tail. A surprise matters chiefly through the resulting NQ path: repeated extension, poor retracement and cross-asset alignment would be the escalation signals.

The U.S. cash-open hour remains the highest pre-FOMC path checkpoint. WATCH assumes opening-auction volatility can still mean-revert; sustained opening continuation with shallow pullbacks would challenge that assumption.

The first full cash-session hour stays at WATCH if the open produces directional persistence but not enough evidence for a block. Meaningful retracement or breadth conflict would support de-escalation.
drivers: Breadth conflict can lower directional conviction

forecast.analysis: Mid-session conditional Tail eases but remains WATCH while the market digests the morning data. Continued extreme-holding after failed rebounds would keep path risk elevated; two-sided rotation would reduce it.
The hour before the FOMC build-up remains WATCH only at the lower boundary. Tail should stay below blocking levels unless a directional regime is already persistent before the policy sequence.
drivers: Persistent directional regime before the meeting
Stress does not automatically raise Tail

forecast.analysis: The pre-FOMC hour moves back to upper WATCH because the multi-stage policy sequence begins at 18:00 UTC. A pre-decision one-way setup would matter more than the scheduled event alone.

The 18:00 UTC FOMC decision and 18:30 press conference create the main event/whipsaw window. Conditional Tail is capped at WATCH unless the actual post-decision NQ path shows repeated extension or mean-reversion failure.

During the press-conference/Q&A hour, upper-WATCH Tail assumes bond-yield reaction could create a delayed second leg. Escalation would require observed directional persistence, not merely the existence of the meeting.

After the main FOMC sequence, conditional Tail eases to WATCH if price discovery becomes two-sided. A delayed equity second leg with failed retracements would instead keep path risk near the upper boundary.

forecastDetail.comment: Cash trading is closed; broad weakness, high oil and yields keep Stress extreme, while fresh mixed tech breadth and absent live NQ path evidence keep Tail low.
At the futures reopen, low Tail depends on two-sided discovery and available retracements; shallow-pullback continuation would move the path toward WATCH.
Late evening remains low-Tail if repeated extension does not develop; oil and rates become Tail amplifiers only with NQ mean-reversion failure.
Midnight UTC remains low-Tail under balanced trade; a directional break followed by failed retracements would invalidate the baseline.
The Asia handoff stays low-Tail if ordinary pullbacks remain available; persistent cross-session continuation would be the escalation checkpoint.
Early Asia stays low-Tail under rotating price action; fresh headline shocks matter materially only if NQ develops sustained directional follow-through.
